title: Stoker’s Wintergreen 16oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco
description:
Stoker’s Wintergreen 16oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco

Stoker’s Wintergreen 16oz Loose Leaf Chewing Tobacco is a classic loose leaf-style chewing tobacco product. Loose leaf chewing tobacco is the most common type of chewing tobacco. It simply consists of shredded tobacco leaves. Stokers Wintergreen 16oz Loose Leaf is manufacture by National Tobacco Company and has a robust tobacco flavour, with hints of wintergreen. The nicotine strength is 2 on a 5-grade scale, placing it within the “normal” range compare to similar chewing tobacco products. Chewing tobacco can also be experience in plug and, fine cut and long cut. You can find more classic chewing tobacco on the Stoker’s brand page.
